title: DynamicInverter
description: Dynamic response model of a grid-connected inverter. It names its function blocks by id: a converter, an active and a reactive power control, an inner control, a DC source, a reference frame rotation (the frequency estimator), a filter, and an optional current limitation. It has no bus of its own: exactly one static injection device, with the same name, names it in its `dynamic_injector` property, and that device supplies the rest of the inverter's data.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the dynamic injection. Must equal the name of the static injection device that names it in `dynamic_injector`.

omega_ref.description: Frequency reference set-point, per unit of the system frequency.

converter.description: ID of the Converter function block: the converter model.

active_power_control.description: ID of the ActivePowerControl function block: the outer active power control.

reactive_power_control.description: ID of the ReactivePowerControl function block: the outer reactive power control.

inner_control.description: ID of the InnerControl function block: the inner control model.

dc_source.description: ID of the DCSource function block: the DC source model.

reference_frame_rotation.description: ID of the ReferenceFrameRotation function block: the frequency estimator (PLL) model.

filter.description: ID of the Filter function block: the output filter model.

current_limitation.description: ID of the CurrentLimitation function block: the output current limiter model, or null when the inverter has no limiter.

base_power.description: Base power for the per-unit parameters of the referenced function blocks. Usually equal to the `base_power` of the static injection device that names this model. Units: MVA.
